candidates.description:
Move method enableBiDi to org.openqa.selenium.firefox.FirefoxOptions
Rationale: The method enableBiDi(FirefoxOptions options) is primarily concerned with setting a capability on the FirefoxOptions instance, specifically enabling the BiDi (Bidirectional) protocol by setting the 'webSocketUrl' capability to true. Since this method modifies the options that configure the FirefoxDriver, it logically belongs in the FirefoxOptions class, which is responsible for managing various settings and capabilities for the Firefox driver. Moving this method to FirefoxOptions will enhance cohesion and encapsulate the behavior related to configuring options, making the codebase cleaner and more maintainable.
